In her previous life, Su Liqian was just an ordinary game designer. But when she opened her eyes, she found herself in an interstellar era that resembled a futuristic world. 
To her surprise, Su Liqian—who had already graduated years ago—had become a student who couldn’t even pass the high school entrance exam. 
In this world, card masters can turn imagination into reality through their cards. 
And so, Su Liqian awakened — carrying with her the memories of 5,000 years of Chinese civilization. 
During this year’s Interstellar Card Tournament, a mysterious young Dream Caster appeared out of nowhere—the youngest in history. 
When her opponent summoned a gigantic beast, the audience in the livestream watched as Su Liqian calmly pulled out a small glowing “container.” 
Then she simply said, 
“I call you once. Do you dare to respond?” 
In an instant, the giant beast vanished on the spot. 
When a dark horse contestant, once considered a top contender, summoned a towering S-rank python, the viewers shook their heads, thinking the match was already over. 
But right then, Su Liqian created a new card on the spot. A long stick with holes appeared in her hand. 
Before the chat could even get nervous for her, they watched as the terrifying beast began to twist and sway along with the sound from the stick. 
And then came the flying “iron sword” in the sky, the strange-looking beasts, and those “people” that didn’t look like anything from any known planet. 
What in the world are all these things?!

110170.synopsis:
She fled into the forest, pregnant with her ex-husband’s child.
A life as the Grand Duchess, filled with countless misunderstandings and persecution—
For Larie, it had always felt like standing at the edge of a cliff.
“How old is the child?”
Two years had passed since she escaped the Grand Duke’s residence.
Her ex-husband had returned, now as the Emperor.
When he finally tracked her down and asked the question,
Larie swallowed dryly and lied.
“…He’s six months old now.”
The child, far from ordinary, looked nothing like a six-month-old.
She hoped he would believe the child wasn’t his.
Only then could Larie be truly free.
But his reply was cold.
“So, our child was born six months ago.”
Then, with a darker expression than before, he barked an order to his soldiers as if chewing out the words:
“Escort the Empress with the utmost respect.”
#HurtHeroine #RegretfulHero #Misunderstandings #Karma #Possessiveness/Obsession #PalaceRomance

110682.synopsis:
Jungmin (Soo)’s close older brother and first love, Yoo Shinwoo, dreams of marrying an Omega and building a sweet, loving family.
For this reason, Jungmin had hoped to become an Omega even before manifesting, but as if fate were playing a cruel joke, he, who so desperately wished for it, became an Alpha. Meanwhile, his twin younger brother, Youngmin, became an Omega and got engaged to Jungmin’s first love.
But Jungmin couldn’t give up on him. He believed that if he could somehow become an Omega, Yoo Shinwoo would look his way. Clinging to this foolish lingering attachment, he kept taking drugs to become an Omega, even though he knew they were poison.
Meanwhile, Kim Joohwan (Gong), who periodically has relations with Jungmin under the pretext of “correction,” watches this with amusement.
Kim Joohwan feels an inexplicable anger and discomfort seeing Jungmin, who is willing to “correct” with any Alpha if it means becoming an Omega.
But it doesn’t matter. No, he wishes Jungmin would suffer even more, be in even greater pain. Because the more Jungmin suffers, the more likely he is to eventually turn to Kim Joohwan.

112474.synopsis:
I possessed the body of a character nobody plays.
A character with absolutely terrible stats.
But then, strange blood flowed through my veins—I couldn’t feel pain—and from the start, I obtained a holy scripture and founded a religion.
You know… this might actually be doable.

114778.synopsis:
The Day the Apocalypse Arrives—No One Has Privileges Anymore.
It doesn’t matter if you’re a child, a man, a woman, or someone with a disability—if you want to survive, you must quickly grasp the rules of survival.
Our only goal is to live—and to keep living.

117338.synopsis:
Bai Wan has been plagued by bugs (in gaming terms) since birth.
Open a door, and it might lead to some unknown place. The water in a cup? It disappears into thin air. But the most absurd of all—at the Mid-Autumn Festival, all he did was take a family photo… and somehow, his entire family turned into paper cutouts!
Then one day, he was unlucky enough to get dragged into a paranormal game—only to awaken an ability even more outrageous: The power to actively create bugs.
And from there, the chaos only escalated.
[Mario’s Coin House] : Entering random sewers in a dungeon leads straight to Mario’s treasure room.
[Sunlight-Absorbing Sunflower] : A cute sunflower appears out of nowhere at the start, absorbs sunlight, and summons Peashooters, Wall-nuts, and other plants to fight the paranormal.
[Reverse World] : Adds a mirror world to the dungeon, allowing the player to see the other side of reality.
[Air Wall Removal Technique] : Deletes the invisible walls of a dungeon, converting it from linear to open-world—map becomes infinite!
[Vanishing Door] : Causes a door to vanish and become a solid wall.
[Care to Watch Me Dance?] : Dancing in front of an NPC gives a chance to receive tips.
[Flirt] : Try chatting up a dungeon NPC—there’s a chance to add their WeChat, and keep in touch even after leaving the dungeon.
[Unexpected Fortune] : Smash random pots in-game to possibly find items belonging to the current dungeon.
By creating bugs, Bai Wan breaks dungeon after dungeon.
associated_names: What Do You Mean the Dungeon Is Glitched? I’m Just Playing the Game Normally
什么卡崩副本？我在正常玩游戏啊

120922.synopsis:
Sota’s best friend, Eiji Makisaka, is a bright and kind-hearted guy who’s always surrounded by people. His childhood friend—and now girlfriend—Kirika Nishizawa is by his side. 
Now an enviable couple, their path to love was marked by a bitter past—
“Get lost. You’re a nuisance. Don’t come back.”
“…I’ll be back.”
A never-before-told episode, penned entirely by the author, is now serialized on *Dengeki Novel Comic+*. This is the untold story of how two childhood “friends” became lovers.
associated_names: 他校の氷姫を助けたら、お友達から始める事になりました side.瑛二

121946.synopsis:
From the travel diaries of a Phoenix Princess reborn from the inferno, chronicling her life on the road with a supposedly “useless” young hero…
On their journey, their fellowship continues to grow: a Dragon Princess of silver frost, a young Vampire Princess with eyes of blood-crimson, the Saintess of Radiant Holy Light, the noble Princess of the White Iris…
“Hmm?” Verafia paused, tilting her head as she gracefully twirled a soft strand of her fiery hair around a finger. A hint of suspicion flickered in her beautiful eyes. “Ignet, why does this sound suspiciously like you’re assembling a harem?”
“My lady, there is a saying: ‘The fish is what I desire, and the bear’s paw is also what I desire.’ A wise man knows that if he can have them both, his home will be harmonious and all his affairs will prosper,” he began, puffing out his chest with the air of a profound philosopher. “Is that not a truly beautiful thing? A… a paragon of peaceful coexistence?”
He faltered under her smoldering gaze.
“…Ahhh! It was a joke! I’m sorry, Milady, please don’t burn me! I swear my only desire is you!”
associated_names: 身为勇者的我竟然成了凤凰大小姐

122202.synopsis:
Cyrus is an ordinary young man living in Gotham, until he obtains a Life Simulator that allows him to experience entirely different lives.
In one simulation, he is a member of the Wayne family. In another, he grows up in Crime Alley. He may become part of the League of Assassins, get involved with the Court of Owls, live an ordinary peaceful life, reunite with the same person across countless lives, be watched over by an older brother, or exist as someone created for destruction.
To Cyrus, these are only simulations. Different possibilities born from different identities, families, and circumstances.
But there is one problem.
Whenever Seres enters a simulation, Bruce Wayne dreams about everything that happens inside it.
Night after night, Bruce watches this mysterious young man become his son, join his family, grow up beside the Bat-Family, suffer, die, and become entangled with Gotham’s most dangerous people and organizations.
The lives may be fake, but Bruce’s memories of them are very real.
And now Batman wants to know exactly who Cyrus is.

123226.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a cultivation world, Li Ye thought he was about to face a tough road ahead in his journey to become an immortal. But to his surprise, this world was overflowing with resources beyond imagination. Powerful cultivators actively regulated market prices, deliberately releasing all kinds of cultivation materials and opportunities to support low-level cultivators, ensuring everyone had a path to immortality.
On top of that, he obtained a five-colored bound panel that allowed him to link spirit beasts and spirit plants. Once bonded, both parties could share their unique traits and even mutate. Through this, he received small gifts from spirit plants and beasts—spiritual energy, evolved spells, rare materials and treasures… even fortune itself!
From then on, he joined the top sect of the Eastern Domain and began a life where farming and cultivation went hand in hand, introducing all sorts of previously unknown spirit beasts and plants to this world. His cultivation journey was smooth sailing.
…As time went on, he began to notice something strange—spirit beasts and plants became increasingly affectionate toward him, his comprehension of nature grew deeper, and even the Heavenly Dao seemed to like him more and more.
associated_names: 共生面板，我在修仙界种田长生

127322.synopsis:
When a person is in the mountains, they become immortal. I am in the mountains, so I became an immortal!
Gu Yuanqing, reborn as a concubine’s son in a prince’s estate, had no cultivation talent and thought he would spend his life as a wealthy recluse lying flat. However, when the Gu Prince’s heir mistakenly captured a weakened Grandmaster-level imperial princess and presented her as a feudal gift, he was imprisoned in the deep mountains, bound to a sacred ground, and set upon the path of longevity.
Observing the mountains to comprehend the Dao, commanding all things, fishing in the heavens—a legend of cultivation begins from here…
Four years later, the Great Gan Emperor brought a young child: “When I pass away, he shall be the Son of Heaven of Great Gan.”
Hundreds of years later, the people of Great Gan pointed to the immortal mist-wreathed mountain towering into the clouds: “According to our great ancestor, back then this North Spring Mountain was only a few hundred zhang tall! Only because there is an immortal in the mountain…”

128090.synopsis:
Tien transmigrates into a female-dominant world, becomes the Saint, and faces the desperate situation of a fallen nation. 
Coincidentally, the cheat promised by the goddess requires dying once to activate. 
The gears of fate begin to turn, and the noble Saint Tien embarks on his own journey of seeking death. 
The loyal female Holy Knight witnesses with her own eyes Tien dying to protect her…
associated_names: 女尊：亡国圣子只想一心求死

144474.synopsis:
Yumemi Renge, a current high school girl who’s a TS reincarnate obsessed with VTubers and also a hardcore yuri fan, has made a bold decision—“I will dominate the VTuber world with a mesugaki (bratty girl) persona!” 
After relentless effort, she successfully debuts as Hanayori Kohaku, and immediately sets out to seduce all her VTuber senpais and peers at her agency… but her bratty girl persona collapses almost immediately!
Despite that, her viewers love it, commenting things like “Brat lol”, “She’s basically Mama Hanayori now lol”, and “Don’t push yourself, Hanayori”. Through collab streams and real-life interactions, she gradually charms her legendary senpais and quirky peers one by one—what will happen next!?
associated_names: TS tensei shita watashi ga shozoku suru Vtuber jimusho no liver wo zenin otoshiniku hanashi
TS転生した私が所属するVTuber事務所のライバーを全員堕としにいく話

144986.synopsis:
This reliable, forty-something adventurer might be too adored by his party?
Soshi, a former corporate s*ave now in his forties, was transported to another world that feels just like a game. There, he became an ‘Awakener,’ a person capable of using skills.
Although the skills he learns are all focused on physical prowess, he diligently grinds his levels, conquers dungeon bosses, and acquires new abilities. By steadily putting in the effort, he finds that a single swing of his mace now packs an absurd amount of power!
He’s even getting promoted through the adventurer ranks at record speed?!
Amidst all this, he ends up partying with a young girl who was abandoned by her former comrades for being ‘useless.’ But under Soshi’s guidance, might her own talents begin to blossom?
associated_names: Ossan Isekai de Saikyo ni Naru
おっさん異世界で最強になる　～物理特化の覚醒者～

148314.synopsis:
The only son of the boss ‘Antonio’, Alessandro is a powerful figure who dominates opponents with overwhelming force and fear. He is known to have “yellow fever,” only taking East Asian women with black hair and black eyes as partners.
Suspended agent River Winstead takes on a perilous undercover mission in exchange for reinstatement—to become the lover of Alessandro, the son of her enemy and her betraying first love, and extract information.
‘You’re not the only one who’s changed, Alessandro. I’ve changed too.’
River, who approached him under a false identity, succeeds in entering his house, where he supposedly never invites any woman, but,
“Then what if, just if… You appearing on this stage, and especially in front of me, is also a trick of God.”
Under his chillingly blue gaze, everything began to go wrong.
“What… exactly is your role?”
Alessandro. The only emotions that should be associated with that man are hatred or resentment.
Because this feeling must never be called love.

153690.synopsis:
This world will soon be destroyed.
However…. I installed way too many mods.

154714.synopsis:
Myung Eunha, a C-Class Guide who was matched with an SS-Class Esper immediately upon manifestation.
He expected it wouldn’t be smooth sailing from the start, but he never imagined it would be a path of thorns.
“If you really cared about me, you should have disappeared without a trace the moment we were matched.”
Despised by his own Esper.
‘The responsibility for failing to perform mandatory guiding lies with the Guide.’
Neglected by the Center and whispered about by people, he wanted to stop living this life.
“I want to dissolve the imprint.”
So he requested the dissolution of the imprint that happened by mistake, something no one would object to…
“If you tell me to roll like a dog, I will. The imprint… just that, please don’t touch just that one thing.”
Why are you clinging to me now?
associated_names: The C-Class Guide Is Now Departing
The C-Rank Guide Is Leaving Now

190554.synopsis:
Four years have passed since the outbreak of the zombie apocalypse.
Moon Bo-yeon has given birth to an adorable son and is living a cosy, happy life in Area 17, while her husband, Joo Do-kyung, quietly reigns as a tyrant. 
Though she endured a fair number of hardships after marrying a husband who severely lacks empathy, Bo-yeon is thoroughly satisfied with her current life. 
Regrets or lingering attachments are a distant memory to her.
Which is to say, she has no desire to go back to the past.
But one day, completely out of the blue, Bo-yeon is thrown back in time to the very day she first met her husband.
“I need a woman. In that sense, you’re quite useful.”
Unlike Bo-yeon, who remembers everything, Do-kyung has forgotten it all.
He looks at Bo-yeon with a freezing glare and treats her with the same cruelty he did in the past.
“Honey, hic, Oppa… W-were you always this much of a pe*vert? Just how much of a pe*vert are you?!”
“Who is ‘Honey’, and who is ‘Oppa’?”
She wants to spill everything to her beloved husband so they can solve this predicament together, but he merely treats Bo-yeon like a crazy woman.
“Joo Do-kyung. From now on, remember only my name.”
Oh goodness. Her beloved husband has turned back into a beloved bastard.
Utterly oblivious to the fact that he is Bo-yeon’s husband, Do-kyung flies into a jealous rage over this mysterious “husband,” leaving Bo-yeon completely bewildered by his reactions.
“Just what kind of power did you get hit by, Oppa? Why do we have to repeat this all over again…?”
Will Bo-yeon be able to convince Do-kyung, deal with the culprit behind this incident, and reclaim her peaceful life?

195674.synopsis:
Start with nothing but a 2×2 plot of soil and build a magical homeland from scratch!
After transmigrating into another world, the protagonist finds herself trapped in a Western fantasy survival game where disasters and magical catastrophes occur without end.
Soil contamination.
Magical corruption.
Elemental riots.
Native uprisings.
In this world, every player is little more than a walking resource node.
Extreme cold brought by Ice Elements, giant plant mutations, acid rain, scorching suns, famine—survival itself is the ultimate challenge.
The objective is simple:
Stay alive, expand your territory, and build the ultimate sanctuary before the final day arrives.
Only after entering the fantasy continent do the players realize the horrifying truth:
This is MAX Difficulty Mode.
Cruel kings and nobles hunt players for sport.
Greedy goblins and dwarves sell players as commodities.
Dragons, druids, and elves regard players as food.
Sirens lure players into traps to obtain scarce resources.
Food.
Everything in this world desires food.
The players are driven to despair.
Then one day, beyond the edge of dreams and farther than the horizon itself, a garden appears.
A garden overflowing with life and magic.
Fairies whisper among the flowers.
Elements resonate in harmony.
Magic itself obeys a mysterious and powerful Witch.
All disasters and corruption are shut out beyond its borders.
Rare fruits grow everywhere, infused with magical fragrance:
Life Peaches.
Mutated Sweet Watermelons.
Bursting Cherries.
To desperate survivors, it looks like paradise.
Players sneak into the garden, hoping to steal some crops.
Only for a fairy to jump out and scold them:
“Don’t steal vegetables! This is the backyard of the Number One Witch!”
The players are stunned.
associated_names: 魔女的农场：生存游戏建造家园

196698.synopsis:
Yun Jue was born in January, belonging to the wood element of injury, with no peace in all matters, and a naturally short life.
Born to fulfill fate, disasters followed one after another, illnesses and pains arose frequently, often struggling on the brink of life and death, yet he still managed to hold on until the age of 25.
Thinking this life would end here, he never expected there would be a miraculous encounter.
478: [Congratulations, chosen one. Because your emotional and intellectual quotients are both higher than average, making you an outstanding figure in this world, you have been specially selected as a Host. Are you willing to follow me through different worlds and complete Missions?] 
Yun Jue: [Alright.] 
478: [Huh? Aren’t you going to ask who I am? What if I’m a scammer?] 
Yun Jue chuckled: [Who are you?] 
478: [478.] 
Yun Jue: [Just died.] 
478: [No, no, no, I’m not cursing you! I mean my name is 478!] 
Yun Jue: [A very nice name.] 
478: [?!] 
The destined Host!
